cause_quote: The commit removed `margin-top: calc(var(--chat-mobile-pane-header-height, 0px) + 50px);` from the transcript viewport in Details-enabled panes, letting the first message and its actions sit under the Details button.
user_saw: On narrow chat layouts, the Details button could cover the first message and its action buttons.
summary: The fix moved Details into the existing pane header, keeping the transcript clear without adding a 50px gap on desktop.
reasoning: The first-parent diffs show that Details already shipped and that two follow-up commits reserved space above the transcript to keep its actions clear. I checked that 7e256f7302d removed that reservation while leaving Details in the gutter, which matches the overlap documented on main in the fix PR and covered by its new geometry assertions.
